body.interpretation: Non-zero-guarded 64-bit increment of the script-frame field at +0x20 (FFrame::NextLocalVar): 0 stays 0, non-zero n becomes n+1. Then load the vtable pointer from [this] (RCX) and TAIL-CALL (JMP, not CALL) the virtual function at vtable byte offset 0xd30 (entry index 334). No other side effects, no return value. The reflected exec entry is only this frame side-effect plus the virtual dispatch; the real handler body lives in the vtable slot.

vtable_resolution.slot_target_meaning: Slot 0xd30 (0x142675530) is a pure virtual forward: it tail-calls the next vtable slot 0xd38 (0x146205240) = 0x142680df0, which is the reset-rotation body.

forward_target.meaning: Reset-rotation body: (a) stores the identity quaternion (global 0x147c31d50 = floats {0,0,0,1}) into TargetRotationOffset (FQuat at 0xf50); (b) if (SelectionProperty (0xf32) - 1 > 1) && (TArray count at 0xe10 > 0) && (array ptr at 0xe08 != 0), it reads the first selected actor (ptr at [0xe08]) and, based on sign-bit comparisons of the actor's rotation floats against the .rodata constants 0x14816c240-0x14816c2ac, either loads the global quaternion at 0x1482184f0 or negates the actor's rotation floats (constants 0x14816c2b0-0x14816c2bc = -1.0) and stores the result into TargetRotationOffset; (c) writes 0 to the two bytes at 0xf44 (bIsRotateClockwisePressed and bIsRotateCounterclockwisePressed); (d) calls the shared RPC helper 0x1428c04b0(this, &TargetRotationOffset, 0, 0) = ServerUpdateRotation; (e) issues a trailing dynamic call 0x1406a9dc0(this+0xd88, &identity_quat) with the 16-byte global 0x147c31d50.

shared_helpers.0x1428c04b0: Shared RPC-issue helper: builds the ServerUpdateRotation param struct {FQuat@0, bool@16, bool@17} and issues ProcessEvent; matches the reflected ServerUpdateRotation(FQuat ClientRotation, bool bNewIsRotateClockwisePressed, bool bNewIsRotateCounterclockwisePressed) at exec 0x1428c5250.

cross_validation: Sibling HandlePullPressed 0x1428c2e20 tail-jumps vtable 0xd70 and HandlePushPressed 0x1428c2e60 tail-jumps 0xd60 (owner q27-11100407); both resolve against the same primary vtable 0x146204508, independently pinning the vtable base.

The reset-rotation forward target stores the identity quaternion 0x147c31d50 = {0,0,0,1} and clears both rotate-pressed bools before issuing ServerUpdateRotation, a semantic match for 'reset rotation'.
remaining_concerns: The vtable dispatch is virtual; a derived-class override of the slot-0xd30 function would change behavior. The concrete AFortCreativeMoveTool target is resolved (0x142675530 -> 0x142680df0), but the .inc preserves the virtual dispatch rather than inlining it.

The forward target 0x142680df0's conditional actor-rotation override reads the first selected actor's rotation floats and compares them against .rodata sign-bit constants (0x14816c240-0x14816c2ac); the exact semantic (which sign pattern selects the 0x1482184f0 global vs the negated-actor path) is not fully resolved, but it does not affect the thunk body proposed here.

The trailing dynamic call 0x1406a9dc0(this+0xd88, &identity_quat) target member (0xd88) and the exact UFunction it dispatches are not resolved; this is inside the forward target, not the proposed thunk.
